name: ecommerce-microservices
description: Cloud-native e-commerce microservices platform (root-level dev tooling only — no runtime dependencies live here; each service under services/ manages its own package.json).

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix services/identity-service && npm install --prefix services/catalog-service && npm install --prefix services/cart-service && npm install --prefix services/order-service && npm install --prefix services/inventory-service && npm install --prefix services/media-service && npm install --prefix services/notification-service
